ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of netcat with the "-e" flag followed by common shells. This could be a sign of a potential reverse shell setup.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/nc$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ncat$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ bsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ csh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ ksh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ pdksh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ tcsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/ash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/csh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/ksh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/pdksh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/tcsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/zsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFSash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFSbash.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFSbsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFScsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFSksh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFSpdksh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFSsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFStcsh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\$IFSzsh.*")))
